escena: SCENE (a press conference lectern, seen straight on at lectern height, in a dark hall): the lectern is NOT a wooden podium — its whole front face is a single long horizontal SEARCH BAR, a rounded rectangular slot glowing softly from within, completely EMPTY except for one thin vertical text cursor standing at its left end. No letters, no numbers, no words, no icons anywhere in it. Standing behind the lectern, only its upper half visible above the glowing bar, the small Codex figure from the reference faces front, addressing the room. FIVE fat foam press microphones on long stems crowd in from the bottom and the sides, angled up towards the figure; they are visibly LARGER than the figure's head, which makes clear it is a small physical figurine about 25 cm tall and not a person. The hall behind is empty and falls to black: no audience, no seats, no banners, no windows. The glowing search bar is the ONLY light source, throwing hard light upward onto the underside of the figure and onto the nearest microphone heads, while everything above and behind drops off into deep navy darkness. Fine dust hangs in the beam. 50mm lens at f/2.8, camera at bar height.

texto.muro: the empty dark hall above the lectern, unbroken and unlit

lecho.objeto: a black flight case standing in the immediate foreground, running unbroken across the whole width of the frame below the microphones
lecho.tono: matte black textured road-case shell in full shadow, outside the light
